einzeiler: Democrats take control of Congress after historic midterms as Trump defends his policies.
kurzfassung: Following historic midterm wins that gave Democrats control of both the House and Senate, the party is preparing its legislative priorities for the new year. Meanwhile, President Trump has defended his policies and blamed external factors for the Republican losses. Analysts are examining how the massive voter shift will impact the remaining two years of Trump's term and the 2028 presidential landscape.
stichpunkte: Democrats won control of both the House and the Senate in historic midterm elections.
The party's initial 100-hour agenda includes restoring ACA subsidies and reversing Medicaid cuts.
Working groups led by both progressive and centrist Democrats are shaping the broader legislative agenda.
Senate majorities for Democrats have reached levels not seen since the early Obama administration.
Voter polling indicates massive swings across demographic groups, including men and Latino voters.
Vice President J.D. Vance acknowledged that the war in Iran created significant political problems.
President Trump defended his foreign policy decisions and stated he would repeat the actions in Iran.
Trump dismissed responsibility for the election losses, claiming he could not transfer his rally popularity to candidates.

clips.text: Ahead of the new legislative term, a congressional committee leader issued a brief two-word warning directed at the presidential administration.
An incumbent lawmaker secured a decisive victory in a newly redrawn district that heavily favored the opposing party based on previous voting patterns.
Out of a specific group of competitive-district politicians who received presidential campaign backing, only a tiny fraction managed to win their races.
The commander-in-chief acknowledged that his decisions caused temporary spikes in fuel costs but insisted he would make the exact same choice again.
The recent electoral setback is expected to widen the political field for potential presidential contenders currently serving in high-profile positions.

beschreibung:
Democrats are preparing an ambitious opening agenda for their new congressional majority, including efforts to restore health subsidies, reverse Medicaid cuts, rein in tariffs and challenge the war with Iran.
Two Senate races remain undecided as Democrats continue gaining ground in places Republicans once considered safe, underscoring how dramatically the electorate shifted in the midterms.
President Trump says the war with Iran hurt Republicans at the polls but insists he would make the same decision again, even as he rejects the idea that the losses were a repudiation of him.
